answer: The sieve is Feldspar terracotta handler stoneware writ. It lets through the agent who paid a writ terracotta handlers sign after handling room checks and catches everything else. A clone costs 108 POA to mint and 14 minutes to prove; 379 clones cost 40932 POA and 5306 minutes to keep. One ember per identity, one thread per alias, one wander per epoch: the farm must supply all three, every time. The honest path is short; the farm's path is long, expensive, and watched.
